title: Validate conditional fidelity without constant acceptance
statement: For the fixed preselected experiment,J|K=k is Binomial(k,theta),even with input-dependent acceptance. K>=Np0/20,J/K>=15/16 certifies z>=K/(2N),theta>=7/8 at confidence1-delta for N=ceil(16000p0^-1ln(4/delta)). Soundness/discovery and full startup costs remain separate.

requires: Decoder, training distribution,tuning,N fixed BEFORE holdout. Trusted qubit preparation/measurements and embedding/projection, independent attempts, stationary memoryless effective channel,fresh discarded program randomness,data independent of training. No isometry/reset source promise needed for certificate VALIDITY.
provides: For the fixed preselected experiment,J|K=k is Binomial(k,theta),even with input-dependent acceptance. K>=Np0/20,J/K>=15/16 certifies z>=K/(2N),theta>=7/8 at confidence1-delta for N=ceil(16000p0^-1ln(4/delta)). Soundness/discovery and full startup costs remain separate.
assumptions: Source promise enters DISCOVERY only: complete p/9 error<=nu p,nu<=1/270,p>=p0 yields pass probability>=1-delta and z_L>p/40 on count-good discovery. Soundness/discovery events differ; use delta/2 each for joint confidence1-delta. Effective-output black-box validation needs Omega(p^-1 ln(1/delta)) attempts; this is not minimax over all physical experiments or proof of globally optimal startup product. No model/Delta/drift validation,adaptive peeking,untrusted device,unassisted capacity or finite-block hashing.
costs: Charge every fresh training program, forward/reverse simulation, rejected/early-stop branches, original noisy datum (+1 call), validation/startup, preparation, holding/memory and classical processing. Gate width/storage depend on output dimension even when sample count does not. Each datum consumes a new bank; no free batching or demonstrated practical advantage. N attempts cost N(n_train+1) original calls plus holding/gates; later attempts still cost n_train+1. Quadratic per-attempt training gives startup O(p0^-3 polylogs), not p0^-2. Any equally informed fixed generic decoder may use the SAME certificate.
contract.units: UNHALVED diamond norm; probabilities/deficits dimensionless. Natural logs except explicit log2/hash rates. Budgets retain source-local time/accuracy parameters.
